answer: Farming becomes a thread bet on surviving 58 epochs of grading, and every nebula settlement recomputes the hollow schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 58 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
